classifications.rationale: The President establishes and staffs an internal White House conference, assigns its purposes, and delegates personnel and compensation-setting authority; any employee compensation determination occurs later through the Executive Director's discretion.
classifications.evidence: There is established the White House Conference for a Drug Free America within the Executive Office of the President.

classifications.rationale: Although the segment also assigns internal management and review functions, it itself prescribes binding compensation ceilings for the Conference's directors, creating a present legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The Executive Director of the Conference shall be compensated at a rate not to exceed the rate of basic pay then currently paid for level III of the Executive Schedule

classifications.rationale: The segment requires reports and recommendations to the President and Congress, including possible legislative proposals, but neither governs agency implementation nor changes legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The Conference shall prepare and transmit a report to the President and the Congress.

classifications.rationale: Executive agencies must share information and are authorized to provide administrative support or detail employees, all of which concerns internal executive coordination and operation.
classifications.evidence: All Federal departments, agencies, and instrumentalities are authorized to provide such support and assistance as may be necessary to facilitate the planning and administration of the Conference.

classifications.rationale: The segment grants officials discretionary authority to procure support services and furnish reimbursable administrative services without dictating any particular contract or external legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Executive Director is authorized to procure contractual services as necessary to support the purpose and functions of the Conference
